scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back again -
- after you store some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 您攜帶的物品太多了。 -
- 請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，再回來。 -

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
How can I assist you today?
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
歡迎來到鍊金術士公會。
請問有什麼可以幫您的嗎？
購買材料
購買製作說明書
退出

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
What would you like?
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
您想要購買什麼？
藥缽 - 8 Zeny
取消

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
How many do you want?
Enter '0' if you want to quit.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
您需要多少？
輸入“0”即可取消。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
The deal was cancelled.
Come again next time.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
交易已取消。
歡迎下次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
The number must
be less than 2000.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
數量必須少於2000。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
You don't
have enough zeny.
Check how much zeny
you have first.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
您的Zeny不足。
請先確認您擁有的Zeny數量。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
It doesn't seem like
you can carry everything.
Please check the space
in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
看起來您無法攜帶所有物品。
請檢查您的背包空間。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
Thank you.
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
謝謝。
歡迎下次光臨。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
Well then,
come again when
you need to purchase
materials related to
Alchemy, alright?
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
以後需要購買鍊金材料，隨時再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
What do you need?
Manuals are generally 100,000 zeny. But there are a couple of special manuals that will cost more.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
您需要什麼？
說明書通常是100,000 Zeny。但有幾本特殊的說明書價格會更高。
一般藥水製作說明書
酒精製作說明書
火煙瓶製作說明書
鹽酸瓶製作說明書
植物瓶製作說明書
刺錘瓶製作說明書
護貝藥製作說明書
纖細藥水製作說明書
取消交易

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
Well then...
Come back if you
ever need to buy
a production manual.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
那麼...以後需要製作說明書，隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
Alright then,
have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
好的，祝您愉快。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
You don't
have enough zeny.
Check how much zeny
you have first.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
您的Zeny不足。
請先確認您擁有的Zeny數量。

[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
{0}？
需要{1} Zeny。
購買
退出

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
Thank you for
your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
感謝您的惠顧。

scripts.text:
[Gever Al Sharp]
Come again
next time.
scripts.translation:
[格維爾·阿爾·夏普]
下次再來。
